name: Multi-Chart VQA Benchmark
description: Measures model performance on question answering about scientific figures that contain multiple plots or charts within a single image.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for VQA on scientific figures; useful to the scientific visualization and VQA research communities but not yet widely adopted outside that niche.
notes: Likely a relatively small, domain-specific dataset focused on multi-plot scientific figures; increased risk of domain shift/contamination from figure corpora and may require specialized visual grounding models.
